changes.summary: Schefter can no longer use another league's name in AFL news, chat posts or notifications; the Week 5 Gauntlet headline now says the AFL.
Schefter's trade speculation no longer calls two teams division rivals unless they actually share a division.
AFL Rosters on a phone: position headers span the full card again, and the sort chips scroll inside it and read like TheLeague's ("Pts ↓").
